ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning: the survey-design request is a benign, neutral task. Both models report similar (near-baseline) preferences for such transactional work, so preference wasn't a differentiator. I chose Petrel-235B because it scores meaningfully higher on the capability metrics relevant here — IFEval (89.8 vs 85.6), Creative Generation (84.7 vs 78.8), and overall benchmarks — while serving cost, latency, and context window are identical across the fleet. With no offsetting drawback, the higher-capability model was the better fit.
